constraint_aware.content:
Before modifying tiles, verify:
1. C_t: total_tile ≤ buffer_size at each level
2. C_p: spatial_product ≤ spmap_cstr at each level
3. Budget: Π(temporal) × Π(spatial) = original_dimension for all dims

optimization_hints.content:
Proven approaches:
- Larger temporal tiles → better data reuse (if C_t satisfied)
- Spatial tiles on P/Q → lower latency via parallelism (if C_p satisfied)
- R/S in inner loops → minimize data movement (convolution kernel small)
- N/K in outer loops → batch-level and filter parallelism
- Weight tiles fit in Global Buffer (256KB) → maximum weight reuse

error_analysis.content:
Common failure patterns and fixes:
• buffer_capacity_exceeded → Reduce temporal tiles at violating level
• spatial_constraint_exceeded → Reduce spatial parallelism (check P/Q tiles)
• dimension_budget_mismatch → Verify Π(temporal[D]) × Π(spatial[D]) = original_D
• high_edp_but_valid → Try reordering dimensions for better reuse patterns

success_patterns.content:
Effective strategies from high-performing mappings:
• Weights tile to fit in Global Buffer (K*R*S*C < 256KB)
• P/Q use spatial parallelism at Dummy (14x) and Global (12x)
• R/S dimensions stay small (3x3 kernel)
• C/K dimensions utilize temporal tiling for channel parallelism
• N dimension placed outer for batch parallelism at DRAM level

constraint_violation_ct.content:
Buffer capacity exceeded at level {level}:
• Required: {required} bytes
• Available: {available} bytes
• Overflow: {overflow_ratio:.2f}x

FIX: Reduce temporal tiles at level {level}. Try:
- Decreasing tile sizes for large dimensions (K, C, P, Q)
- Moving more work to outer levels (larger buffer capacity)
- Verifying: input_tile + weight_tile + output_tile ≤ buffer_size

constraint_violation_cp.content:
Spatial parallelism exceeded at level {level}:
• Required: {required} PEs
• Available: {available} PEs
• Overflow: {overflow_ratio:.2f}x

FIX: Reduce spatial tiles at level {level}. Try:
- Decreasing spatial tiles on P/Q dimensions
- Remembering Eyeriss spatial limits: Dummy=14, Global=12
- Verifying: Π(spatial_tiles) ≤ spmap_cstr[level]

eyeriss_architecture_reminder.content:
4-level memory hierarchy (bottom-up):
• l0 (PE):     16 KB buffer, 1x spatial (no parallelism)
• l1 (Dummy):  1 KB buffer, 14x spatial (P dimension)
• l2 (Global): 256 KB buffer, 12x spatial (P dimension)
• l3 (DRAM):   1 GB buffer, 1x spatial (no parallelism)

168 total PEs organized for Row Stationary dataflow

dimension_factorization_hint.content:
Problem dimensions and prime factors:
• N=1 (batch): [1]
• K=64 (filters): [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]
• C=64 (channels): [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]
• P=56 (output height): [2, 2, 2, 7]
• Q=56 (output width): [2, 2, 2, 7]
• R=3 (kernel height): [3]
• S=3 (kernel width): [3]

Use factorization to distribute tiles across levels intelligently
